headline: Paraguayan President Resigns Amid Central Bank Intervention and Ueno Bank Crisis
summary: The central bank intervention in Ueno Bank left nearly 3 million depositors without access to funds, led to 27 indictments, and resulted in the resignation of President Santiago Peña.
why: Political instability and banking sector crises can severely disrupt local credit markets, foreign investments, and sovereign debt risk.

impacts.name: Paraguay
impacts.why: A presidential resignation and banking crisis create systemic political and economic uncertainty.
